status: causal intervention in a frozen engineered rate model; not fly-brain thought extraction

design.decoder: independent supervised ridge class readout on L2-normalized native 2% KC hidden vectors; lambda 0.1 fixed without tuning
design.decoder_boundary: old 32 training labels only; native MBON policy is not used to select intervention targets
design.target_selection: baseline decoded class from the independent probe; ground truth is evaluator-only
design.intervention: after native top-k and max normalization; native MBON evaluation receives silenced activity without renormalization
design.matched_count: top, random, and bottom conditions remove exactly ceil(fraction*active_count) active KC units
design.magnitude_caveat: the original top/random/bottom grid is count-matched but differs in removed L1; the later post-hoc random_l1matched25 control matches top-25% removed L1 exactly while changing the number of affected units
design.replication_caveat: three checkpoints change learned MBON weights only; PN-to-KC hidden features and decoder are identical, and repeated case rows are not independent encoder replicates
design.agreement_proxy: per-case decoded/native class agreement is a descriptive correlation proxy, not a statistical correlation coefficient
design.saliency: KC coefficient contribution is hidden_activity * (train_hidden_basis.T @ dual_coefficients) for the independently decoded class
design.data: reused 32-case confirmation set; exploratory, not a fresh holdout

posthoc_random_l1matched25.status: added after observing the count-matched intervention results; exploratory and not preregistered
posthoc_random_l1matched25.method: random active-unit order; fully silence until the per-row top-25% L1 target, then partially attenuate one unit to match exactly
posthoc_random_l1matched25.comparison: existing random_active_25pct is equal-count; random_l1matched25 is equal-removed-L1 but changes a variable number of units
posthoc_random_l1matched25.target_boundary: uses the independent decoder prediction and top-25% contribution magnitude target, never the evaluator label
